messages.subject: Mentor's manual
parts:
Mentors:

To find the manual, you can go to

https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/resources/

when you are logged in to your dashboard. If you are not logged in, then
you only get presented the opportunity to view the student manual.
This is also available from the Help at the bottom of the dashboard.

Note that the flossmanuals.net site seems to be a bit flakey. The ebook
version link does not function (at least for me). I sent a note to
Google about a couple of bad links, and we went back and forth a couple
of times because there are the context dependencies of being logged in
and so forth, so we were supposedly on the same "page", but seeing
different displays. The joys of dynamic information!

Be watchful for "old" information about melange. It is not being used
this year.

I also found that going to the link above and trying to log in did NOT
work. Just ignored the login.

JN
